title: Condiciōnēs: Quattuor Genera
subtitle: Simplex (factum), irreālis (contrā factum), futūra vīvida (ἐάν+coni.), futūra minus vīvida (εἰ+opt.) — systēma completum condiciōnum Graecārum.
objectives: Distinguere quattuor genera condiciōnum Graecārum per fōrmam prōtasis ("sī"-clausulae) et apodosis (clausulae prīncipālis/resultātūs)
Cōnstruere condiciōnem simplicem (factum): εἰ + indicātīvus, indicātīvus
Cōnstruere condiciōnem irreālem (contrā factum): εἰ + indicātīvus praeteritī, ἄν + indicātīvus praeteritī
Cōnstruere condiciōnēs futūrās (vīvida: ἐάν + coniūnctīvus, futūrum indicātīvum; minus vīvida: εἰ + optātīvus, ἄν + optātīvus)

content.intro: Condiciō Graeca cōnsistit ex duābus partibus: prōtasis ("sī"-clausula, cum εἰ/ἐάν) et apodosis (clausula prīncipālis/resultātūs). Graecum distinguit quattuor genera condiciōnum secundum quantum probābilis/reālis est condiciō ipsa — systēma multō magis fīnum quam Latīnum (quod habet trēs genera similia sed nōn identica).
content.explanation: Discrīmen inter quattuor genera nōn est sōlum tempus chronologicum, sed gradus probābilitātis/reālitātis ā vīsū locūtōris: factum indubitābile (simplex), factum negātum contrā reālitātem (irreālis), possibilitās probābilis futūra (vīvida), possibilitās remōtior/hypothetica futūra (minus vīvida).

rules.heading: a) Cōnspectus: Quattuor Genera
rules.body:
GenusPrōtasis (εἰ...)Apodosis
1. Simplex (factum)εἰ + indicātīvus (quōlibet tempore)indicātīvus (sine ἄν)
2. Irreālis (contrā factum)εἰ + indicātīvus praeteritī (imperf./aor.)ἄν + indicātīvus praeteritī
3. Futūra vīvidaἐάν (=εἰ+ἄν) + coniūnctīvusfutūrum indicātīvum (sine ἄν)
4. Futūra minus vīvidaεἰ + optātīvusἄν + optātīvus

rules.heading: b) Exempla Applicāta
rules.body: 1. Simplex: εἰ τοῦτο λέγει, ἁμαρτάνει. “Sī hoc dīcit, errat” [neutrāle, sine implicātiōne dē vēritāte]. 2. Irreālis (praesēns): εἰ τοῦτο ἔλεγεν, ἡμάρτανεν ἄν. “Sī hoc dīceret [nunc, sed nōn dīcit], errāret”. Irreālis (praeteritum): εἰ τοῦτο εἶπεν, ἥμαρτεν ἄν. “Sī hoc dīxisset [sed nōn dīxit], errāsset”. 3. Vīvida: ἐὰν τοῦτο λέγῃ, ἁμαρτήσεται. “Sī hoc dīcet [probābiliter], errābit”. 4. Minus vīvida: εἰ τοῦτο λέγοι, ἁμαρτάνοι ἄν. “Sī hoc fortasse dīceret, errāret [hypothetice]”.

rules.heading: c) Nōtae Praecipuae
rules.body: ἐάν (crasis ex εἰ+ἄν) est REQUĪSĪTUS cum coniūnctīvō in prōtasī — coniūnctīvus in clausulā subōrdinātā generāliter requīrit ἄν additum ad particulam intrōductōriam (patrōnus quem posteā vidēbis etiam in clausulīs relātīvīs/temporālibus indefinītīs). Ἄν in apodosī (genera 2 et 4) est ESSENTIĀLE — sine eō, indicātīvus/optātīvus perderent sēnsum condiciōnālem. Genus 1 (simplex) et genus 3 (vīvida) apodosis NUMQUAM habent ἄν.

examples: εἰ σοφός ἐστιν, εὖ λέγει. — Sī sapiēns est, bene loquitur. (1, simplex)
εἰ σοφὸς ἦν, εὖ ἂν ἔλεγεν. — Sī sapiēns esset, bene loquerētur. (2, irreālis praesēns)
εἰ ταῦτα ἐποίησεν, εὖ ἂν ἔπραξεν. — Sī haec fēcisset, bene sē habuisset. (2, irreālis praeteritum)
ἐὰν σοφὸς ᾖ, εὖ ἐρεῖ. — Sī sapiēns erit, bene loquētur. (3, vīvida)
εἰ σοφὸς εἴη, εὖ ἂν λέγοι. — Sī fortasse sapiēns esset, bene loquerētur. (4, minus vīvida)
εἰ μὴ ἦλθες, οὐκ ἂν εἶδες τὸν βασιλέα. — Sī nōn vēnissēs, nōn vīdissēs rēgem. (2, negātīvum, μή in prōtasī, οὐκ in apodosī)

commonMistakes.wrong: Adhibēre εἰ (nōn ἐάν) cum coniūnctīvō in prōtasī, omittendō ἄν necessārium.
commonMistakes.right: Adhibēre semper ἐάν (εἰ+ἄν combīnāta) cum coniūnctīvō in prōtasī condiciōnālī.
commonMistakes.why: Coniūnctīvus in prōtasī requīrit ἄν obligātōriē — cōnstrūctiō *εἰ + coniūnctīvus sine ἄν nōn exsistit in Atticō classicō.

commonMistakes.wrong: Omittere ἄν in apodosī generum 2 et 4 (irreālis, minus vīvida), scrībendo indicātīvum/optātīvum sōlum.
commonMistakes.right: Includere semper ἄν in apodosī generum 2 et 4 — sine eō, sēnsus condiciōnālis perditur omnīnō.
commonMistakes.why: Ἄν in apodosī est signum morphologicum obligātōrium horum generum, distinguēns eōs ā simplicī affirmātiōne.

commonMistakes.wrong: Cōnfundere negātiōnem in prōtasī (semper μή, in omnibus quattuor generibus) cum negātiōne apodosis (variābilis secundum modum).
commonMistakes.right: Recordārī prōtasis semper adhibet μή (etiam cum indicātīvō! — exceptiō speciālis ad rēgulam generālem οὐ/μή), apodosis sequitur rēgulam normālem prō modō suō.
commonMistakes.why: Prōtasis condiciōnālis est ūna ex paucīs cōnstrūctiōnibus ubi μή adhibētur cum indicātīvō, contrā rēgulam generālem (Gradū II).

items.prompt: Quod genus condiciōnis adhibet ἐάν + coniūnctīvum in prōtasī?
Quod genus adhibet εἰ + indicātīvum praeteritī, ἄν + indicātīvum praeteritī?
items.explanation: Genus 2 (irreālis): duo indicātīvī praeteritī, cum ἄν in apodosī.

items.prompt: Habent genera 1 (simplex) et 3 (vīvida) ἄν in apodosī?
items.explanation: Ἄν in apodosī appāret sōlum in generibus 2 et 4.

options: particula nova, sine relātiōne ad εἰ
items.explanation: Ἐάν est combīnātiō εἰ+ἄν, requīsīta cum coniūnctīvō.

items.prompt: Quae negātiō adhibētur in prōtasī condiciōnālī, in omnibus quattuor generibus (etiam cum indicātīvō)?
items.explanation: Prōtasis semper adhibet μή, exceptiō notābilis ad rēgulam generālem.

exercises.title: Complē cum Fōrmā Rēctā
exercises.instructions: Comple spatia cum fōrmā rēctā condiciōnis.

items.prompt: εἰ σοφὸς ἦν, εὖ ἂν ___. (indicātīvus imperf., genus 2, "loquerētur")
εἰ σοφὸς εἴη, εὖ ἂν ___. (optātīvus, genus 4, "loquerētur")
εἰ ___ ἦλθες, οὐκ ἂν εἶδες τὸν βασιλέα. (negātiō prōtasis)
items.explanation: Prōtasis adhibet μή, etiam cum indicātīvō.

exercises.title: Vērum an Falsum
exercises.instructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

items.statement: Graecum distinguit quattuor genera condiciōnum, secundum probābilitātem/reālitātem, nōn sōlum tempus.
Ἐάν adhibētur cum indicātīvō, sīcut εἰ.
items.explanation: Falsum: ἐάν requīrit coniūnctīvum, distīnctum ā εἰ + indicātīvō.

items.statement: Ἄν in apodosī generum 2/4 potest omittī sine mūtāre sēnsum.
items.explanation: Falsum: ἄν est essentiāle prō sēnsū condiciōnālī horum generum.

items.statement: Prōtasis condiciōnālis semper adhibet μή, etiam cum indicātīvō, exceptiōnāliter ad rēgulam generālem.

summary: 1. Simplex: εἰ + indic., indic. (sine ἄν) — factum neutrāle.
2. Irreālis: εἰ + indic. praeteritī, ἄν + indic. praeteritī — contrā factum.
3. Futūra vīvida: ἐάν + coni., fut. indic. (sine ἄν in apodosī) — probābile.
4. Futūra minus vīvida: εἰ + opt., ἄν + opt. — hypotheticum/remōtius.
Ἐάν (=εἰ+ἄν) requīsītum cum coniūnctīvō; ἄν in apodosī essentiāle prō generibus 2/4; prōtasis semper μή.
